faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We have compiled the most frequently asked questions from our clients

questions.question: How much does labor consultation cost?
questions.answer: Costs vary depending on the type and duration of consultation. The basic consultation fee is [amount], and for detailed information, please contact us by phone or online inquiry.

questions.question: When can I receive a response after applying for online consultation?
questions.answer: Generally, we respond within 24-48 hours on business days. It may take some time depending on the complexity of the case.

questions.question: Is in-person consultation possible?
questions.answer: Yes, it is possible. Please make a reservation by phone or online in advance for smooth consultation.

questions.question: Is personal information managed safely?
questions.answer: Yes, your personal information is thoroughly managed according to our privacy policy, and consultation content is kept confidential.
